title: Warning about Ishmael's murder plot against Gedaliah
description: Johanan son of Kareah and the army commanders came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and warned him that Baalis, king of the Ammonites, had sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take his life. But Gedaliah would not believe them. Johanan offered secretly to kill Ishmael to prevent the Jews from being scattered, but Gedaliah rejected him and called the accusation a lie.
